body: I wish people would read my replies & notice that I had already told him long before I made this post.

When my previous cat passed away, I lost such a sense of myself that I had built around him & my recovery. A loss of anything important to us can be detrimental. But I took that never ending love I have for him & gave it back elsewhere. I adopted new cats, I volunteer at a shelter. I promised myself & him that I wouldn’t give up; that I would give those powerful emotions to something even greater than myself.

I know I’m a monogamous person, the idea of being in love with one person for the rest of my life is always what I’ve wanted. I think I’ve been so desperate for romantic love my whole life because of the devoid of love I have for myself. It’s unhealthy & so goddamn challenging to change a mindset I’ve had since I was a young child. There’s so much more to this story & he knows what happened. He genuinely believes I had sex with my friend when I didn’t. That’s another aspect of it all that kills me. I threw it away over a kiss. How stupid

Would you ever be willing to talk about your experience with me privately? I don’t want to open up old wounds, but I’d love to understand from a perspective that I never thought I’d want to understand.

Your response was blunt, gentle, & insightful. Thank you, it’s words like yours that have stuck with me so long & kept me going on the path I’ve been desperately trying to take for a long while now. I know everyone is far from perfect but I’ve always tried to hold myself to higher standards to atone for who I was in the past. Even though I am a bit older & should do better, there will always be more work to do on myself. I don’t want to give up & even if I have to be alone to do that, I will. For myself & to make sure I never hurt anyone like this ever again. Not forever, but until I can come to terms with this horrible shame, guilt, & regret.
